sloka: संहस्कन्धो महाबाहुर्मनस्वी प्रियदर्शनः ।पितृवद्वर्तते रामे मातृवन्मां समाचरन् ।। ५.३८.६०।।।।
transliteration: saṁhaskandho mahābāhurmanasvī priyadarśanaḥ ।pitṛvadvartate rāme mātṛvanmāṁ samācaran ।। 5.38.60।।।।

translations.english: "Lakshmana, who has lionshoulders and strong arms, who is handsome, who takes Rama as his father and treats me as his own mother.
